evidence_items.explanation: The reported comparison found invented dependencies in foundation models and coding agents, supporting a concrete reliability and supply-chain risk. It also found predominantly clean foundation-model outputs and substantial reductions with agent reasoning and validation, which limit any claim of pervasive or unavoidable failure.

unresolved_gaps: The research does not establish that hallucinations are unavoidable in every possible LLM architecture or surrounding system.
